entry.title: Social Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Hermes Desktop Bot Screen Launch (lead story): The week's dominant story is the coordinated launch of Bot Screen live desktop passthrough for Hermes Desktop. @Teknium's launch announcement (~1,150 likes) and @NousResearch's real-time agent-streaming post anchor the wave, with the official @tonbistudio walkthrough + docs (548 likes) serving as the onboarding path. Sentiment is strongly positive and anticipatory — replies like 'Finallllly!' and a 20k-view 'Much needed!' signal this was a long-requested capability landing exactly as hoped. oh-my-hermes (OMH) Plugin Ecosystem: @rlaope shipped a major OMH update adding Jev-Skills and model routing (Jev models/aliases, skills and plugins, workflow routing, fast decisions) and positioned OMH as the all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent power users. Jev Evaluation Tooling: Alongside the plugin update, @rlaope open-sourced jeval for Jev model evaluation and visualization, plus jev-ask/jev-XYZ skills in oh-my-hermes Updated+ — tangible ecosystem tooling, though the duplicate share saw near-zero engagement. Official Support & Engagement: @Teknium and @NousResearch stayed highly responsive in the replies — pointing a user to Hermes via iMessage with any model, correcting provenance (a tool credited to Anthropic is actually built by Nous Research), triaging a reported cache bug with a request for repro steps, and confirming a community-reported issue was fixed. Minor chatter: a lukewarm community take on Opus 5.5 vs Claude Code (notable only because Opus 5.5 GA'd the day before coverage), an open call for followers to share their GitHub builds, and assorted hype/emoji replies. Excluded from the ranking: duplicate link drops, vague one-word reactions ('Impressive!'), and low-substance emoji threads.
